title: Promote statusline and ccreport from macsetup to own repo
description:
The statusline and ccreport tooling currently lives in /Users/ove/git/macsetup/claude as flat PEP 723 scripts sharing a directory-level sys.path. Move it to this repo (/Users/ove/git/ccreport) as a proper src/ccreport package.

Source files: ccreport.py, statusline_command.py, cache_db.py, pricing.py, exchange.py, project_identity.py, get_claude_usage.py, banner_demo.py, benchmark_statusline_energy.py, statusline-command_x.sh, ccu.zsh, tests/ (11 files), docs/calculation-reference.md, CLAUDE.md (the AUDIT calculation reference), ruff.toml.

Decisions already made with the user:
- Layout: src/ccreport/ package. Modules become ccreport.pricing, ccreport.cache_db etc. Wrappers keep the sys.path + __pycache__ import trick, pointing at src/.
- History: fresh copy, no git-filter-repo. One commit on top of b9a0c6f.
- macsetup originals: LEAVE IN PLACE. Do not delete them and do not repoint mbp2022/settings.json, sbnorge/settings.json, zshrc/gadgets/claude_code/bin/ccreport, bin/ccu or dotlinks/dotlinks.toml. That cutover is a separate approved step.

Acceptance: just lint-all and just test pass in this repo; bin/ccreport and bin/statusline-command_x.sh run from a clean checkout; macsetup keeps working untouched.

Move cache, snapshot and config paths from macsetup/claude to ccreport
description:
The tooling still writes to paths named after its old home:
- src/ccreport/cache_db.py:29  DB_PATH = ~/.cache/macsetup/claude/cache.db  -> ~/.cache/ccreport/cache.db
- src/ccreport/cache_db.py:33  _DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT_DIR = ~/.local/share/macsetup/claude/snapshots
- src/ccreport/project_identity.py:29  CONFIG_PATH = $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/macsetup/claude/ccreport.toml

The live DB is 163 MB of irreplaceable ccreport_records, so the move must not be a silent copy-on-next-run: an unmigrated machine would start a fresh empty DB and the old one would sit there unread. Add a 'ccreport migrate' command that moves the existing data to the new locations, is safe to run twice, and reports what it moved or found already done.
acceptance: ccreport migrate relocates an existing ~/.cache/macsetup/claude/cache.db; running it again is a no-op that says so; a machine with no old data exits cleanly; tests cover all three cases.

description: Move statusline-command_x.sh, ccu.zsh and the zshrc gadget's ccreport wrapper into bin/ in this repo and repoint their DIR resolution at src/. Both bash wrappers cache a resolved interpreter keyed on the script mtime and import rather than exec the module so CPython caches bytecode — keep that. acceptance: just lint-all passes; bin/ccreport --help and a piped-stdin run of bin/statusline-command_x.sh both produce output.
notes:
Done. bin/ holds ccreport, statusline-command_x.sh and ccu.zsh.

Both bash wrappers dropped the PEP 723 machinery: this is a uv project now, not a set of inline-dependency scripts, so 'uv sync --script' plus 'uv python find --script' and the TMPDIR interpreter cache are all gone. They exec $REPO/.venv/bin/python directly, which is what the resolver was costing ~40ms per run to arrive at. The -c BOOT string that imports rather than runs the module — the thing that gets CPython to cache bytecode — is unchanged.

The status line falls back to python3 from PATH when there is no venv, because it and usage_api import nothing outside the stdlib. ccreport cannot: it needs orjson and rich, so it builds the venv once and errors if that fails.

pyproject.toml: orjson and rich are real dependencies now, plus a [project.scripts] ccreport entry point. macsetup's ruff.toml is folded into [tool.ruff] — line-length 110 and the full ignore list, not the scaffold's 88. just fmt no longer runs 'ruff format'; the wrapping in this tree is hand-chosen and a format pass rewrapped 1435 lines before that was caught.

pyright went from strict to standard: strict reported 5987 findings on this code, standard reported 71, and all 71 are fixed. 'just lint-all' passes.

cache_db.relocate_legacy_paths() does the move and returns one line per path moved. The cache *directory* is renamed whole rather than cache.db alone, so the -wal and -shm sidecars travel with it: a DB moved without its WAL loses every transaction still in it. get_connection calls it when DB_PATH is missing and the legacy dir is present, so the move is automatic on first open. 'ccreport migrate' calls the same function and reports; 'ccreport migrate --dry-run' lists without moving. Both are a no-op the second time.

12 tests in tests/test_migrate.py.

description: Move statusline-command_x.sh, ccu.zsh and the zshrc gadget's ccreport wrapper into bin/ in this repo and repoint their DIR resolution at src/. notes:

pyproject.toml: orjson and rich are real dependencies now, plus a [project.scripts] ccreport entry point. macsetup's ruff.toml is folded into [tool.ruff] — line-length 110 and the full ignore list, not the scaffold's 88. just fmt no longer runs 'ruff format'; the wrapping in this tree is hand-chosen and a format pass rewrapped 1435 lines before that was caught.

pyright went from strict to standard: strict reported 5987 findings on this code, standard reported 71, and all 71 are fixed. 'just lint-all' passes.
closed_reason: Wrappers exec .venv/bin/python directly; ruff at 110 with no formatter, pyright at standard, both clean.

description:
The statusline and ccreport tooling currently lives in /Users/ove/git/macsetup/claude as flat PEP 723 scripts sharing a directory-level sys.path. Move it to this repo (/Users/ove/git/ccreport) as a proper src/ccreport package.

Source files: ccreport.py, statusline_command.py, cache_db.py, pricing.py, exchange.py, project_identity.py, get_claude_usage.py, banner_demo.py, benchmark_statusline_energy.py, statusline-command_x.sh, ccu.zsh, tests/ (11 files), docs/calculation-reference.md, CLAUDE.md (the AUDIT calculation reference), ruff.toml.

Decisions already made with the user:
- Layout: src/ccreport/ package. Modules become ccreport.pricing, ccreport.cache_db etc. Wrappers keep the sys.path + __pycache__ import trick, pointing at src/.
- History: fresh copy, no git-filter-repo. One commit on top of b9a0c6f.
- macsetup originals: LEAVE IN PLACE. Do not delete them and do not repoint mbp2022/settings.json, sbnorge/settings.json, zshrc/gadgets/claude_code/bin/ccreport, bin/ccu or dotlinks/dotlinks.toml. That cutover is a separate approved step.

Acceptance: just lint-all and just test pass in this repo; bin/ccreport and bin/statusline-command_x.sh run from a clean checkout; macsetup keeps working untouched.
closed_reason: All children done. Both tools run from their own repo; macsetup keeps only the pre-split copy under claude/orphaned_ccreport/.

title: Promote statusline and ccreport from macsetup to own repo

title: Convert ccu.zsh to ccu.py
Convert ccu.zsh to ccu.py
acceptance: ccu and ccu --json produce the same output as the zsh version for the same usage row; jq is no longer required; pytest covers the rendering; bin/ccu.zsh is gone.
notes:
Done. src/ccreport/ccu.py replaces bin/ccu.zsh, which is deleted.

Output is unchanged — verified byte-for-byte against the zsh on the same usage row, at CLAUDE_CODE_PACE_DAYS of 3, 5 and 7, and on the argument-error path (both print the same usage line and exit 2).

jq is gone. So is the zsh: the repo has no shell beyond the three bin wrappers.

74 tests in tests/test_ccu.py cover the bar, the verbose countdown and its plurals, the reset line (today / tomorrow / further out / midnight / past / unparseable), the pace line and its five colour bands, the last-fetched header, section selection for optional quotas, main()'s exit codes, and fetch_usage against a stubbed subprocess. They pass under UTC, Europe/Oslo, America/New_York, Asia/Kolkata and Pacific/Chatham.

On the reuse question the issue asked me to check: the countdown and bar could not be shared. The status line renders a compact countdown ('1d2h') for a one-line bar and has no 50-cell meter at all; ccu renders words ('1 day and 2 hours'). Same delta, different products. What was genuinely shared is pace_days(), which now lives in pricing.py — both read CLAUDE_CODE_PACE_DAYS and two copies would drift. ccu also takes the week start from pricing.window_start_epoch() instead of the zsh's 'reset minus seven days'; they agree except when the reset has already passed, where the zsh went negative and printed nothing.

The fetch stays a subprocess. usage_api.main() owns a file lock, a cache TTL and a fetch-failure backoff on behalf of every reader, and reports by printing and exiting — calling it in-process would mean catching SystemExit and capturing stdout. It is also the seam the tests stub.

ccreport master: bd05733. The macsetup PATH forwarder needed its target changed from bin/ccu.zsh to bin/ccu; that edit is live and verified but left uncommitted.
